description: Source code implementing trigger parsing and handling for a home automation or IoT system, including various trigger types such as sensor, touchscreen, lighting, door lock, thermostat, time, cloud, and Zigbee communication status. Contains functions for parsing XML trigger definitions, allocating and freeing trigger structures, and managing trigger lists.

methods.name: icrule_alloc_trigger
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a trigger structure based on XML node content and trigger type.

methods.name: free_multitrigger_map
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a hashmap value, typically a linked list.

methods.name: parse_sensor_trigger
methods.description: Parses a sensor trigger XML node and appends the trigger to the list.

methods.name: parse_touchscreen_trigger
methods.description: Parses a touchscreen trigger XML node and appends the trigger to the list.

methods.name: parse_lighting_trigger
methods.description: Parses a lighting trigger XML node, creating multiple triggers based on light IDs and states.

methods.name: parse_doorlock_trigger
methods.description: Parses a door lock trigger XML node, creating triggers for specified door locks and states.

methods.name: parse_thermostat_bounds
methods.description: Parses thermostat bounds (low/high temperature) from XML.

methods.name: parse_thermostat_trigger
methods.description: Parses a thermostat trigger XML node, creating triggers for specified thermostat IDs and states.

methods.name: parse_thermostat_threshold_trigger
methods.description: Parses thermostat threshold trigger XML node, creating triggers for temperature bounds.

methods.name: parse_time_trigger
methods.description: Parses a time trigger XML node, including time slots and repeat intervals.

methods.name: parse_cloud_simple_eval
methods.description: Parses simple cloud evaluation criteria from XML.

methods.name: parse_cloud_complex_eval
methods.description: Parses complex cloud evaluation criteria from XML.

methods.name: parse_cloud_trigger
methods.description: Parses a cloud trigger XML node, creating a trigger with cloud object ID and evaluation criteria.

methods.name: parse_cloud_service_trigger
methods.description: Parses a cloud service trigger XML node.

methods.name: parse_zigbee_comm_status_trigger
methods.description: Parses Zigbee communication status trigger, creating triggers based on device ID and status.

methods.name: icrule_free_trigger
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a trigger, calling specific free routines based on trigger type.

methods.name: icrule_parse_trigger_list
methods.description: Parses a list of triggers from an XML node, creating trigger structures for each recognized trigger type.
